_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic). ROOT scalar fields come from the Meta Marketing API /insights reference; BREAKDOWN dimensions from the Insights breakdowns reference; action-family metrics are EXPANDED from the ads-action-stats action_type list.
_derivation.expansion_rule: For each EXPANDED AdsActionStats family F (actions, action_values, cost_per_action_type, conversions, conversion_values, cost_per_conversion) and each official action_type A, a flattened metric id is emitted as '<F>_<A>' with A's dots normalised to underscores (e.g. actions_offsite_conversion_fb_pixel_purchase). This mirrors how the Graph API returns these arrays keyed by action_type and how Supermetrics flattens the same arrays, which is why the merged counts converge on the same order of magnitude as their 537 metrics / 254 dimensions catalog. Long-tail families (unique_actions, ROAS variants, outbound-click variants, ...) are emitted only as their raw json array field, not itemised per action_type.
_derivation.count_divergence: Metric total (~574) lands on the order of the Supermetrics 537 figure. Dimension total (55) is intentionally below their 254: Supermetrics counts every breakdown VALUE permutation (per-country, per-age-bucket, per-placement, per-asset) as a distinct dimension column, whereas this catalog declares each breakdown ONCE as a parameterised dimension. Enumerating breakdown values is out of scope (they are query parameters, not catalog fields) and would be non-deterministic against the account's data.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/facebook-ads-fields.md -o server/modules/meta-ads/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: Meta insights takes a comma-joined fields= param over a time_range on the selected ad account. The probe batches up to 20 fields per request over a 1-day window; a batch that returns an invalid_request (Graph OAuthException on an unknown field) is bisected so the exact rejected field is captured.

breakdown_compatibility._note: Story 25.8: consumed at request-build time by pull_catalog_daily. Maps each catalog dimension whose section is a real Insights breakdown (TARGETING / PLACEMENT / ATTRIBUTION / some CONVERSION) to the Meta `breakdowns` param name (source_field == breakdown token). Structure/grain dimensions (CAMPAIGN DETAILS + TIME: campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, date, account_*, ...) go in the `fields` param, NOT breakdowns, and are omitted here. Incompatible combos are refused BEFORE the API call (invalid_request).

excluded_sections.CREATIVE ASSET: Asset-level breakdowns (image_asset, body_asset, ...) require the asset-level Insights request shape (breakdowns on creative assets return one row per asset variant) which pull_catalog_daily does not build; excluded until the asset request shape is implemented.
excluded_sections.VIDEO: Video engagement families (video_p25/50/75/100_watched_actions, ...) are returned as nested action-array shapes with a distinct parsing contract not yet implemented in _parse_catalog_row.
excluded_sections.APP: App-event breakdowns (app_id) need an app-scoped Insights request shape not built by pull_catalog_daily.

_exposure_note: Story 25.8: after catalog_driven execution exists, exposure = reachable through pull_catalog_daily. The generator marks a field `exposed` when it is a scalar Insights root field OR an action-family expansion OR a declared breakdown (all reachable). The families below stay `excluded` WITH an exclusion_reason because pull_catalog_daily does not implement their request shape.
